snippet.title: Emoji Ball Keeps Bouncing Until It Hits the Center Ball... #satisfying
snippet.description:
Satisfying visual ASMR physics simulation. One emoji ball keeps bouncing inside a square hole in a wall of blocks until it hits the center ball. That ball breaks the blocks, and every broken block becomes another bouncing ball. This chain reaction spreads across the grid until the balls fill the screen, then they all drop in a most satisfying ending.
